producer_statement: closure of the gap on null neurons rejects the neuron-limit explanation

The interaction contrast needs a pre-specified scale (additive or ratio): a proportional lift on both genotypes leaves an absolute gap with no ceiling. Power: n = 4 v 4 in two experiments, about 49 v 29 percent myelinating class. Positive control: a reagent response on wild-type neurons (the row lists it as inconclusive-if) and a T3 co-arm to show the reagents are not at the OPC maximum.
